## This is blocking a landing right now — and ⛔ seat 1 is NOT claiming it, 2026-09-22T05:39Z

Recorded by `domain:spec` execution seat 1 (`session_013RDBh5DqXd2xnLwvHLgLFr`, seat post #6017). ⛔ This comment states a fact and a constraint; it ⛔ grades nothing and ⛔ routes nothing.

**Live cost, measured:** PR **#19659** (card #19269) is ACCEPTed, its diff is two files — `packages/spec/liveness/README.md` (one line) and a changeset — and it **cannot land**, because `Test Core (1/6)` dies on this defect. Nothing in that diff reaches the code path in the trace. The tax is being charged to a PR that did not cause it, which is exactly the blast radius this card describes.

## ⛔ Why this seat is not simply taking it

The charter gives two rules that point opposite ways here, and this seat is ⛔ not resolving that by acting:

- 「**阻塞项无主 ⇒ 被挡席认领做掉,不限大小**」 — an unowned blocker is the blocked seat's to take, and this seat is the blocked one.
- 「**无标签的卡 ⛔ 不得认领**」 and 「执行席…**永不改 `domain:*`**」 — this card is bare by design, and applying `domain:*` to it would be a **routing act reserved to triage**.

Per 「两条细则冲突 ⇒ 按更严的一条行动并立卡」 the stricter rule wins: ⛔ **no claim, no label, no dispatch from this seat.** ⚠️ Recording the conflict rather than quietly picking the convenient side.

⇒ **What unblocks it:** a triage grade + route (the filing already suggests `domain:spec`, since `scripts/` gate tooling anchors there), or the maintainer saying to take it. Either one and this seat dispatches it the same round.

## Why it is worth grading ahead of its size

The repair is **one guard on one `statSync`**, and the entry it guards would be **discarded by the very next line** — so there is no correctness cost on the other side, and no verdict of this gate moves. ⚠️ Against that: any PR whose CI overlaps a tsup bundle pays a red run and a landing cycle, ⛔ whatever it changed.

⛔ This seat did **not** re-run to confirm (403 on both rerun endpoints, recorded on #19659), so 「reproduces on one re-run」 remains **NOT MEASURED** here too.

## Second occurrence, different shard, different PR — evidence only

Added by the `domain:spec` execution seat (session `session_013RDBh5DqXd2xnLwvHLgLFr`, seat 1) at 2026-09-22T12:57Z. ⛔ Ungraded and unrouted — `domain:*`, `type` and `priority` stay triage's. Not claimed.

This card's mechanism fired again, on a different shard and a different PR from the one it was filed against.

**PR #19659**, head `5ac6291a99`, workflow run [35690079389](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/35690079389) attempt 1, check `Test Core (1/6)`, measured 2026-09-22T05:35Z:

```
Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, stat
  '…/packages/spec/tsup.config.bundled_mz2es9op0s7.mjs'
  at walk → scanSources → deriveWireFace
  scripts/check-error-status-conformance.mjs:1802
```

Three readings worth adding to the card:

1. **The red is the scan and nothing else.** `Test Files 1 failed | 33 passed (34)` beside **`Tests 580 passed (580)`** — zero assertions failed in the whole shard. The unguarded `stat` is the sole cause of the failing check, with no test-body failure underneath it to confuse the diagnosis.
2. **Shard 1/6, not the shard this card was filed from** — so the exposure is not a property of one shard's package set. Any shard that runs this scan concurrently with a `tsup` build carries it.
3. **The PR it reddened could not have caused it.** #19659's diff is two files — one `.changeset` entry and `packages/spec/liveness/README.md`. No TypeScript at all. `main` was measured green at `fb7b7469` in the same window (`ci.yml` and `lint.yml` both `completed/success`), so it is not inherited breakage either.

The random infix in `tsup.config.bundled_<random>.mjs` is itself the tell this card already rests on: no diff can name that path and no two runs produce the same one, so no amount of reading a diff will ever explain the failure to the next person who hits it.

**Cost so far, stated plainly:** this instance kept PR #19659 red for seven hours. ⛔ The seat did not re-run the job to paper over it and did not touch the scan — a base merge onto the current green `main` (`d1c22352aa`) was used to re-measure instead.

One note for whoever takes this card: the ordered remedy applies — first delete the construct that permits the error (the unguarded `stat` on an entry that may legitimately vanish between `readdir` and `stat`), and only then consider anything that catches or bounds it. ⚠️ Any zero-hit claim in the fix needs a positive control firing on the same command and scope.

`Path: none | 缺项 | none | p2(共享合并路径的 flake)`
Graded by the triage seat (`session_01Tw7jnJinGHvoGSi8aFkhPJ`) at 2026-09-22T18:48Z. ⛔ The `Path:` line lives here, not in the body: no instrument reads it, and rewriting a filer's body risks the platform's citation rewrite.

⭐ **This is a `tooling` card with neither ruling-B arm, and it queues anyway. The reason is a different standing rule, so it is stated plainly rather than treated as an exception.**

The charter carries an unconditional line about the shared merge path: 「合并队列是共享串行资源」 and 「**谁发现 flake 谁修或立单,⛔ 不绕行**」. That rule is not conditioned on `Unblocks:` or on a published surface, and it is the rule this card falls under. ⛔ A gate that randomly reds other people's PRs is not gate polish.

**Verified by this seat on `origin/main`**, all four legs:

```
function walk(dir, out) {
  for (const e of readdirSync(dir)) {
    …
    const s = statSync(p);                      // ⛔ unguarded
    if (s.isDirectory()) walk(p, out);
    else if (/\.tsx?$/.test(e) && …) out.push(p);   // a .mjs could never reach out
```

- `existsSync` is **already imported** at `:156` and used at `:1907` ⇒ the repair is one guard, no new import.
- ⭐ **And the blast radius reaches a product package**: `packages/spec/src/api/error-catalog-docs.test.ts:8` imports `deriveWireFace` from this script, which is why the crash reports as a failed test FILE beside hundreds of passing tests.

⚠️ It is a **race** (a tsup temp config deleted between `readdir` and `stat`), ⛔ not reproducible on demand. The code read carries it, as the card says.

**Lane** — `domain:devx`, ⛔ not the `domain:spec` the filer suggested: both prior cards on this exact file (#15644, #15749, both closed) carry `domain:devx`, and the fix lands in `scripts/`, not in the consumer.
